# שגיא חתן & יהב מלכה — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> שגיא חתן & יהב מלכה is a boutique real estate entrepreneurial team with a young, sharp, and highly analytical identity. The duo combines backgrounds in entrepreneurship, technology, business analysis, project management, and real estate processes to deliver deep, transparent, and strategically grounded work in urban renewal and land opportunities. The brand intentionally avoids corporate scale messaging, instead projecting the image of a serious, hungry, and exceptionally prepared team entering the market with intelligence and authenticity. The aesthetic draws from luxury boutique consulting firms and modern architecture studios — clean, restrained, and premium without being flashy.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About שגיא חתן & יהב מלכה
שגיא חתן & יהב מלכה is a boutique real estate entrepreneurial team with a young, sharp, and highly analytical identity. The duo combines backgrounds in entrepreneurship, technology, business analysis, project management, and real estate processes to deliver deep, transparent, and strategically grounded work in urban renewal and land opportunities. The brand intentionally avoids corporate scale messaging, instead projecting the image of a serious, hungry, and exceptionally prepared team entering the market with intelligence and authenticity. The aesthetic draws from luxury boutique consulting firms and modern architecture studios — clean, restrained, and premium without being flashy.

## Target Audience
- Apartment owners in urban renewal projects, landowners, investors, brokers, and real estate professionals
- בעלי דירות בפינוי-בינוי
- בעלי קרקעות אסטרטגיות
- משקיעי נדל"ן אסטרטגיים

## Industry
Real Estate
